ruler revert

Revert ruler configurations from supported AI agents

Options:
      --version       Show version number                              [boolean]
      --help          Show help                                        [boolean]
      --project-root  Project root directory                  [string] [default:
  "<LAB>/.lab-runs/f-ruler-package"]
      --agents        Comma-separated list of agent identifiers: agentsmd,
                      aider, amazonqcli, amp, antigravity, augmentcode, claude,
                      cline, codex, copilot, crush, cursor, factory, firebase,
                      firebender, gemini-cli, goose, jetbrains-ai, jules, junie,
                      kilocode, kiro, mistral, opencode, openhands, pi, qwen,
                      roo, trae, warp, windsurf, zed                    [string]
      --config        Path to TOML configuration file                   [string]
      --keep-backups  Keep backup files after revert  [boolean] [default: false]
  -v, --verbose       Enable verbose logging          [boolean] [default: false]
      --dry-run       Preview changes without writing files
                                                      [boolean] [default: false]
      --local-only    Only search for local .ruler directories, ignore global
                      config                          [boolean] [default: false]
